release_notes: Improved serial telemetry resilience, including better handling of disappearing, busy or temporarily unavailable COM ports.
Improved serial auto-connect diagnostics with more detailed probe results for debugging connection issues.
Improved handling of stale or queued serial tone events after reconnects.
Added regression tests for serial controller behaviour, including an optional live Morsewurst hardware probe.
Fixed and refined several Finnish translation strings.
General bug fixes, stability improvements and user experience refinements.
